original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished story environment for an otome 2.5D/3D character content package. Vertical portrait 9:16 image. Premium cinematic realistic 3D rendering, beautiful restrained textures, physically coherent room geometry, crisp details, soft natural lighting. No people, silhouettes, body parts, human reflections, text, titles, captions, logos, watermark or bottom lettering. No identifiable country, real city, brand or street address. Single continuous full-frame evening interior of Cole's small neighborhood bar, a story's previously visited setting. Quiet modest cozy local venue: warm wood counter along one side, dark stools, subdued amber wall lamps, understated shelves with unbranded bottles and glasses, a few small tables and chairs, visible clear path from counter toward an ordinary exit door. Friendly lived-in coastal neighborhood atmosphere, tasteful understated decor; no VIP club, no opulent lounge, no stage. Eye-level wide-enough room view with balanced foreground, late evening blue darkness beyond windows. The setting must not depict a confrontation, romance, drinking person or any character. No legible signage, brand bottles or city identifiers.
